name: sondar-proyect
description: This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

scripts.start:all: cd Backend && npm run start_server & cd ../Frontend && npm run start_front
scripts.install_all: npm install -i && cd Backend && npm install -i && cd ../Frontend && npm install -i
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start_server" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend -- --host localhost --port 3001 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:all:lan: concurrently "npm run start_server" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
